_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/bank.jsx BankExport (L158-253) + openBatchConfirm (real-forms2.jsx L463). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source. crumb* render the breadcrumb. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, baht U+0E3F, right-arrow U+2192, curly quotes U+201C/U+201D in cardSub, slash-separated brands). Values present in i18n-full.json.phrases resolve via tp(); values in _missing are flagged for the Wave-2 i18n round (P2-WEB-15). filterToast fires as a client-intent toast (no server filter). The settings-card values (fBankVal/fDateVal/fFormatVal/fMemoVal) are the prototype's illustrative static display — the server owns the file format (env-selected, fake default) and defaults value_date; they are not interactive inputs. exportBtn POSTs the selected PVs to /bank/export-batch and shows the real returned file. Cancel reuses common.cancel via t().
